items.prompt:
The original text an author borrows from is the:
A) source material
B) conclusion
C) title page

Reshaping borrowed material for a new purpose is to:
A) transform it
B) copy it exactly
C) delete it

A connection between two texts is called an:
A) intertextual connection
B) index
C) epilogue

A modern play retells a Greek tragedy but makes the chorus speak as refugees. The author:
A) draws on the tragic form and transforms the chorus for a modern crisis
B) invented everything with no source
C) copied the tragedy exactly
items.answer: A) draws on the tragic form and transforms the chorus for a modern crisis

solution.answer: A) draws on the tragic form and transforms the chorus for a modern crisis

items.prompt:
Why TRANSFORM source material instead of copying it?
A) to give familiar material new meaning for a new audience
B) to avoid originality
C) it is required by law
items.answer: A) to give familiar material new meaning for a new audience

solution.answer: A) to give familiar material new meaning for a new audience

items.prompt:
A poem that answers an earlier poem by arguing the opposite view is:
A) transforming the source by countering it
B) leaving the source unchanged
C) unrelated to the source
items.answer: A) transforming the source by countering it

solution.answer: A) transforming the source by countering it

items.prompt:
A novel keeps a myth's hero-quest pattern but makes the 'monster' an unjust social system. This BEST shows the author:
A) drawing on a source's pattern while transforming its meaning
B) inventing a plot with no source
C) only summarizing the myth
items.answer: A) drawing on a source's pattern while transforming its meaning

steps: Pattern kept, meaning changed. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) drawing on a source's pattern while transforming its meaning

items.prompt:
To analyze how a work draws on and transforms a source, you should identify:
A) what it borrows AND how it reshapes it for a new purpose
B) only the page count
C) only the author's name
items.answer: A) what it borrows AND how it reshapes it for a new purpose

solution.answer: A) what it borrows AND how it reshapes it for a new purpose
